review_kind: fourth successor Phase 0 correction: preserve v1 facades and capability-gate only P4 authorization

supersedes.disposition: Under 0082, 0081 M09 is disposed at design level by retaining HistoricalStudyVerifier(LifecycleAuthority), HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver(HistoricalStudyVerifier), bind, capture, and ordinary v1 capture behavior unchanged. Only the proposed authorize_capture_set doorways require the broker-issued exact P4 capability. 0075 M02-M05, 0077 M06-M07, and 0079 M08 remain retained requirements; no earlier evidence is edited.

authority_and_limits.authorization: 0082 independently authorizes exactly this fourth successor Phase 0 design correction. RED, implementation, test edits, merge, deployment, and real activity remain disabled pending a fresh independent zero-Critical/Major Phase 0 verdict.
authority_and_limits.non_claim: This is one in-process synthetic P4 authority design only. It does not claim ADR-0123 OS-owned durable authority, restart reconstruction, cross-process locking, closure of R23, a parser/CLI/compose route, protected-data access, replay, HPO/refit, backtest, paper/live activity, or deployment. ADR-0126 deferred coordinated multi-private-mutation attacks remain deferred.

v1_authority: LifecycleAuthority ABC: produce, seal, publish, capture, open_capture
inventoried_current_surface.compatibility_rule: The existing verifier accepts a valid LifecycleAuthority exactly as it does now, pins that exact object, and retains its bind/capture behavior. The existing driver accepts the exact verifier and retains class-bound capture delegation. A normal v1 authority remains a positive legacy route and is not P4-capable.

public_contracts_and_fixed_composition.LifecycleAuthority: Unchanged public ABC and unchanged v1 abstract set. CapturedAuthorizationAuthority is also a LifecycleAuthority instance, not a parallel lifecycle writer: its inherited legacy capture method and its P4 method share one writer, one transition lock, and one lifecycle ledger.

CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.kind: Public nonconstructible ABC/capability surface exported beside LifecycleAuthority. It inherits the unchanged v1 abstract set and adds abstract authorize_capture_set(...). Direct ABC construction refuses.
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.method: authorize_capture_set(captures, admission_ref, *, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces) -> tuple[CapturedAuthorizationRecord, LaunchSession]
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.input: captures is an exact nonempty built-in tuple of exact built-in (published, frozen, derived_port) tuples in complete PlannedCaptureSet order. admission_ref is exact built-in IssuanceBasisRef.v1 for the selected action-execution or final-replay admission. Existing v6 run, SHA-256, identity, cardinality, ordering, duplicate, live-head, and nonce rules remain closed. There is no authority, signer, keyring, resolver, clock, revocation source, contract, ledger/store, lock, callback, factory, provider, path, URL, session, artifact bytes, adapter, or override parameter.
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.output: CapturedAuthorizationRecord and LaunchSession(kind='captured-authorization-v2') are opaque, identity-bound, nonmapping, noncopyable, nonpickleable, and expose no bytes, member/provider, signer, resolver, store, lock, dependency, or construction capability. P4 creates no _Captured, VerifiedCapture, or CapturedBindings capability.
CapturedAuthorizationAuthority.broker_issued_exactness: The authority broker alone registers an exact final concrete instance during construction. Every P4 entry checks exact registered object identity, private broker attestation, exact final class identity, and the immutable class-owned dispatch capsule; isinstance alone is insufficient. Registration, attestation, dispatch capsule, dependencies, and graph have no public mutation, serialization, or reconstruction API.

synthetic_private_authority.kind: _SyntheticP4CapturedAuthorizationAuthority is private, exact final, nonconstructible except with a private one-shot factory token, permanently deployment_eligible=false, and refuses direct construction/copy/deepcopy/pickle/reduce/state/mapping reconstruction.
synthetic_private_authority.sole_factory: Only _development_p4_broker(*, fixture_facts=None), a new private fixed synthetic factory, constructs and registers it. It takes no dependency object, class, wrapper, callback, store, lock, signer, keyring, resolver, clock, revocation authority, contract, session, or per-call override and returns only the public CapturedAuthorizationAuthority capability.
fixed_graph: _LifecycleAuthorizationLedger and its one capture-transition lock domain
synthetic_private_authority.fixture_data: fixture_facts is hostile closed data only. The factory accepts only an exact recursively copied/canonicalized built-in mapping/list/bytes grammar, rejects aliases, subclasses, callables, objects, unknown keys, paths, URLs, stores, handles, and noncanonical values, and loads copied facts only into the fixed WORM resolver. It cannot select code, trust root, key material, signature policy, clock, revocation policy, resolver implementation, ledger, or lock.
synthetic_private_authority.v1_preservation: _development_broker(...) retains its exact current signature and byte-for-byte v1 behavior, has no P4 opt-in, and never returns the P4 capability. The P4 capability is nevertheless a LifecycleAuthority instance, so it is valid at the preserved verifier constructor and remains the only P4-capable authority.

held_dependencies.contract: _FixedCapturedAuthorizationContract only prepares and verifies an immutable batch from a fixed resolver snapshot. It cannot reserve/consume/abort admissions, write/lookup a ledger, construct sessions/events, open members/providers, import, construct, execute, output, invoke a callback, or spend authority.
held_dependencies.resolver: The fixed WORM resolver recursively closes the selected admission, all signed artifacts, IssuanceBasis.v1, and exact refs: canonical grammar, named self, SHA-256, Ed25519, role/use, trusted time, revocation, exact basis/ref kinds, cycles, future output, and action/replay adjacency. No request supplies bytes beyond copied fixture facts, a generation, path, URL, fallback, store, resolver, callback, or trust root.
held_dependencies.integrity: Before preparation and again inside the sole transition lock before commit, the authority verifies exact private dependency identities/classes, immutable construction commitments, broker attestation, and final dispatch capsule. Dependencies expose no getter and retain only copied frozen state. Any mismatch, replacement, unexpected result, or altered commitment refuses before preparation or ledger entry.

HistoricalStudyVerifier.constructor: HistoricalStudyVerifier(authority) remains the existing LifecycleAuthority constructor: it accepts any valid isinstance(authority, LifecycleAuthority), identity-pins that exact authority, and neither constructs nor upgrades it. bind and capture remain unchanged and ordinary v1 capture remains available through the held v1 authority.
HistoricalStudyVerifier.new_method: authorize_capture_set(captures, admission_ref, *, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces) -> tuple[CapturedAuthorizationRecord, LaunchSession]
HistoricalStudyVerifier.gate_and_dispatch: The new method accepts no second authority or dependency argument. Before any effect it requires exact HistoricalStudyVerifier self, the current operational authority identical to the constructor pin, that already-held object to be isinstance(CapturedAuthorizationAuthority), and private broker attestation of that exact object plus the exact registered final class and immutable class-owned authorize_capture_set dispatch capsule. It invokes only that capsule. A plain v1 authority refuses before prepare, legacy receipt, P4 record/ledger, admission, session/event, member/provider, import, construction, execution, output, or release effect.
HistoricalStudyVerifier.refusals: No assignment, late injection, replacement, second verifier, adapter, duck, wrapper, composition proxy, subclass, virtual ABC registration, bound-method/instance override, copied verifier state, pickle/reduce/state rebuild, or reconstructing __dict__/slots converts this facade into a P4 route. The verifier owns no P4 writer/state/lock/ledger/admission/receipt/session/event capability.

HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.constructor: HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver(verifier) remains the existing exact HistoricalStudyVerifier constructor and identity pin. It does not construct a verifier and accepts no authority, P4 authority, factory, fixture, dependency, or override separately.
HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.legacy: capture remains the current exact class-bound delegation to its same bound verifier and therefore preserves ordinary v1 capture behavior.
HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.new_method: authorize_capture_set(captures, admission_ref, *, consumer_run_identity, process_measurement_sha256, runtime_sha256, transition_nonces) -> tuple[CapturedAuthorizationRecord, LaunchSession]
HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.delegation: At call time it rechecks exact driver-held verifier identity/class and invokes HistoricalStudyVerifier's checked exact class-bound authorize_capture_set on that one verifier. It never accepts or injects/swaps a P4 authority and owns no writer/state/lock/ledger/admission/receipt/session/event. Wrapper, subclass, duck, copy, pickle, state reconstruction, attribute swap, instance/class rebinding, or monkeypatched callable paths refuse before P4 effects.

M02_to_M08_retained_transaction.one_domain: _LifecycleAuthorizationLedger remains private and authority-owned. Its sole mutex is the same LifecycleAuthority capture-transition lock used by direct legacy and both facade routes. One record domain contains per-live-identity heads/claims, admission state, execution-key uniqueness, complete P4 batch, session identity/nonce, and SessionStartRecord; there is no second admission store or cross-store coordination.

states.execution_key: canonical (study_id, canonical execution_authority_ref bytes, logical_execution_id, run_id)

M02_to_M08_retained_transaction.legacy: Validate outside and inside the shared lock; atomically transition PUBLISHED through LEGACY_COMMITTING to CAPTURED_V1 while appending the v1 receipt, binding/interning the legacy session, and recording its sole start identity. Later P4 sees CAPTURED_V1 and refuses before P4 reservation/batch/session/admission effect.
M02_to_M08_retained_transaction.p4: The fixed contract resolves and prepares/verifies without authority effect. Under the same lock, recheck exact PUBLISHED heads, unused nonces/admission, absent key, dependency commitments, fixed snapshot, complete field adjacency, frozen live projection, broker attestation, and dispatch capsule. The one immutable commit first consumes the admission, then publishes/mints the complete verified port/receipt/set/replay batch, session identity, and atomic SessionStartRecord, then transitions all identities to P4_COMMITTED without releasing the lock.
M02_to_M08_retained_transaction.resolver_and_basis: The held recursive resolver retains full ADR-0125 basis closure: P(CES)==P(BVP)==P(CAS)==P(StageAdmission or FinalReplayEntry)==ordered PlannedCaptureSet==ordered live captures by complete PCE bytes/cardinality, with exact action/replay admission, signer/use, time, revocation, self/preimage, predecessor-publication, port/receipt/set, replay-evidence, and session-decision adjacency.
M02_to_M08_retained_transaction.failure_retry_race: Preparation, verification, dependency, fixture, trust, mutation, or precommit failure leaves heads PUBLISHED and admission UNUSED; only lock-private reservation is discarded and a corrected retry is legal. The commit publishes one complete record or nothing. An uncertain post-boundary caller resolves exact key/admission before any remint. Legacy/P4 races serialize on the one lock; all listed capture/open/bind/member/consume/release routes refuse for P4_RESERVING/P4_COMMITTED matched identities before effect, while unrelated ordinary v1 remains positive.
M02_to_M08_retained_transaction.prepared_and_session: Prepared bytes are private, inaccessible, nonserializable, and nonauthoritative until same-ledger publication. Session identity/nonce and canonical SessionStartRecord are fields of the same committed record; postcommit opaque interning/return cannot mint another session or event. This preserves M02-M08 without claiming durable/restart consume-once closure.

v1_compatibility: _development_broker remains accepted by HistoricalStudyVerifier; existing bind/capture and HistoricalStudyCaptureDriver.capture, including test_driver_delegates_bound_verifier_capture, stay green.

A valid v1-only authority verifier and driver refuse authorize_capture_set before all capture receipt, P4 record/ledger, admission, session/event, member/provider, import, construction, execution, output, and release effects; direct ordinary v1 capture remains positive.
p4_positive_and_facades: Only private _development_p4_broker capability succeeds through direct authority, verifier class-bound method, and driver class-bound method using its one held authority/ledger.

P4 action and replay one/multi-PCE positives retain exact complete batch, sorted set/evidence, recursive basis closure, atomic admission plus SessionStartRecord, and no open/import/construct/run/output/release route.

Attempt verifier/driver authority or verifier swap, late P4 injection, alias replacement, subclass, duck, wrapper/proxy/decorator, instance/class rebinding, bound-method substitution, copied/pickled/reduced/state/dict/slots reconstructed authority/verifier/driver, and copied verifier state; only the pinned exact broker-attested final capability can reach P4 and every substitute refuses before effects.

Mutate one attestation, final-class registration, dispatch capsule, signer/keyring/resolver/clock/revocation/contract/ledger/lock/internal table before prepare, between verifier dispatch and authority lock, during reservation, and before commit; each refuses or leaves no effect. ADR-0126 coordinated multi-private rewrites are documented as deferred.

Retain exact public signatures; opaque mapping/subclass/duck/wrapper/internal-table refusals; request/cardinality/order/duplicate/live/head/run/runtime/nonce mutations; resolver/basis/ref/key/use/signature/time/revocation/cycle/future substitutions; issuer ordering; partial failures/retry; post-freeze mutation; atomicity; and no-effect sentinels.
